name: Borella Butchery
description: Family run butcher on Borella Road in East Albury selling grass fed beef, Angus, Wagyu, Tasmanian lamb, pork and chicken. Smallgoods are made on site in wood fired smokers, and the counter also carries dry aged beef, sausages, BBQ rubs and sauces, chef prepared meals and pastry items. Free local delivery is offered.
highlights: Smallgoods made on site in wood fired smokers
Grass fed beef, Angus and Wagyu

name: Locky's Countryside Meats
description: Butcher shop on Macauley Street in Albury stocking beef, pork, lamb and chicken. It carries a large selection of continental smallgoods including hams, salami and smoked meats, and supplies halal meat in a range of quantities. Retail and commercial packs are available with delivery.
highlights: Continental smallgoods, hams, salami and smoked meats

name: Wolki Butchery
description: Self serve butchery on Urana Road selling grass fed and pasture raised beef, lamb and pork from Wolki Farm. The shop describes itself as Australia’s first 24/7 self serve butchery, with access open around the clock to members. Membership is free but places are limited.
highlights: Self serve butchery open 24/7 to members
Grass fed and pasture raised beef, lamb and pork

name: Arnold's Fruit Market
description: Fruit and vegetable market on Osburn Street in Wodonga that also carries meat, groceries, bakery, dairy and confectionery. The business traces back to 1892 when J.G Arnold began selling fresh fruit and vegetables in Albury and is now in its fifth generation of family ownership. An online shop and delivery service covers Albury Wodonga and surrounding areas, and Brian’s Nursery operates within the store.
highlights: Trading since 1892, five generations of family ownership
Fresh fruit and vegetables plus groceries, meat, bakery and dairy
Online shop with delivery around Albury Wodonga

name: Miss Amelie Gourmet
description: Fine food provedore selling pies, heat and eat meals, desserts, pastries, deli items, seafood, pantry products and wine. The business won Australia’s Best Gourmet Pie in 2022 with its Chinese BBQ pork belly pie, and has stores in Wodonga, Albury, Beechworth and Prahran Market.
highlights: Pies, heat and eat meals and desserts
Stores in Wodonga, Albury, Beechworth and Prahran Market

name: Cellar Door Wine Store
description: Boutique wine retailer and wine bar on the main street of Beechworth. It stocks an extensive selection of boutique Beechworth wines along with imported and rare wines and a range of spirits from around the world.
highlights: Wine bar as well as retail store
On Ford Street in the town centre

name: Olive Health Foods
description: Health food store on Olive Street that describes itself as the largest health food store between Melbourne and Sydney. It stocks vitamins, minerals and herbs, natural makeup and skincare, water filters, eco friendly and allergy friendly products, local products and sports supplements. An in house clinic offers naturopathic consultations, allergy and intolerance testing and seminars.
highlights: Allergy friendly and eco friendly products

name: A Zesty Health
description: Health food shop on High Street Wodonga stocking organic, eco friendly and chemical free products alongside supplements and whole foods. Lines include nuts, seeds, legumes, grains, herbs and spices, dried fruit, sourdough bread, protein powders, essential oils, medicinal mushroom powders and skincare, with a focus on plant based, gluten free and dairy free diets. Nutrition consultations are also offered.
highlights: Bulk nuts, seeds, grains, herbs and spices
Gluten free, dairy free and plant based lines

name: Wholefoods
description: Organic grocery store on Romet Road in Wodonga stocking organic fresh produce, pantry staples, bread, eggs, frozen food, home and cleaning products, beauty items, beverages, wellness supplements, baby and kids products and pet food. Click and collect is available, and there is a second store in Wangaratta.

name: BOOKtique Albury
description: Independent bookshop in AMP Lane off Dean Street, Albury. Stock is spread across more than 60 categories including fiction, children’s books, crime and thrillers and science fiction, alongside journals, cards and gifts. Audiobooks are sold through a Libro.fm partnership.
highlights: Children’s books, crime and science fiction

name: Thistle & Fern
description: Florist with a shop in South Albury and a second location at Junction Square in Wodonga, selling seasonal fresh flowers, arrangements, gifts and greeting cards. Deliveries run Tuesday to Friday, with a flat delivery rate covering Wodonga, Albury, Lavington, Glenroy, Springdale Heights, Hamilton Valley, Thurgoona, Killara and Bandiana.
highlights: Shops in South Albury and Junction Square Wodonga
Flat rate delivery across Albury Wodonga suburbs

name: Jannoel Floral Co.
description: Florist on High Street in Wodonga selling fresh flower bouquets and arrangements for a range of occasions, with delivery across Albury Wodonga and a same day delivery option.

name: Peards Nursery Albury
description: Garden centre at the Peards site on Borella Road, Albury, selling plants, trees, pots and water features alongside giftware and homewares. The nursery opens every day from 8:00am and there is a cafe on site serving coffee and meals.

name: Peards Nursery Wodonga
description: Nursery on Elgin Boulevard in Wodonga carrying a large range of indoor and outdoor shrubs, trees and seedlings, plus garden giftware and accessories. The business has been locally owned and operating for more than 40 years.
highlights: Indoor and outdoor shrubs, trees and seedlings

name: Our Native Garden Nursery
description: Nursery supplying native plants local to the Albury Wodonga region for revegetation projects, landscaping and home gardens, propagated from locally sourced seed. It sits next to the Re-use Shop at the Wodonga Transfer Station, with parking at the Re-use Shop, and opens Friday mornings and Saturday middays.
highlights: Indigenous plants local to the Albury Wodonga region
Stock for revegetation, landscaping and home gardens
Next to the Re-use Shop at Wodonga Transfer Station

name: Comet Cycles
description: Bike shop on Dean Street, Albury selling road, mountain, gravel, fitness, kids and e-bikes along with parts and cycling accessories. The workshop handles everything from tune ups to custom builds, aiming to complete repairs on the spot where possible and quoting in advance otherwise.
highlights: Road, mountain, gravel, fitness and e-bikes

name: Border Bikes AW
description: Bike shop on Chapple Street, Wodonga handling sales, servicing and repairs. It is a stockist for major bike brands and offers tune ups, custom part fitting, personal bike fitting, spare parts and help with delivery or pick up of bikes. The business started in 2014 as Cycle Station in the Albury CBD.

name: Adventure Gear Albury
description: Outdoor shop on Dean Street, Albury stocking hiking, camping and travel gear. Departments cover apparel, footwear, packs and bags, hydration, nutrition, navigation, optics and lighting, and repair and survival gear. Brands carried include Osprey, Fjällräven, Icebreaker, La Sportiva, Rab, Patagonia, Helinox, Lowa and Exped.
highlights: Brands include Osprey, Fjällräven, Icebreaker and Rab
On Dean Street in central Albury

name: Great Outdoors Albury
description: Outdoor and heating store on Wagga Road, Lavington selling barbecues and pizza ovens, wood heaters and gas heaters, outdoor furniture and umbrellas, camping equipment and prospecting gear, plus gas bottle refills. It is a Weber specialist dealer and calls itself the Border’s wood heater specialists.

name: All Music Direct
description: Musical instrument shop on Dean Street, Albury selling acoustic, electric, bass and classical guitars, amplifiers, keyboards and pianos, orchestral and folk instruments and drums. It also carries studio and live equipment including microphones, mixers, cables and audio interfaces, and has a guitar technician on staff.

name: Art Parts Fine Arts Supplies
description: Art supply shop on David Street, Albury stocking acrylic, gouache, oil and watercolour paint, stretched canvas, boards and rolls, mediums, brushes, easels, drawing tools, printmaking supplies, paper and journals. The shop also runs creative workshops and sells gift certificates.

name: Gemglow Jewellers
addressLine: Shop 10, City Walk Arcade, 515-519 Dean Street
description: Family jewellers in the City Walk Arcade off Dean Street, Albury, established in 1961. The business specialises in handmade bespoke jewellery, jewellery repairs and gifts, and carries pearl and silver jewellery.
highlights: In City Walk Arcade off Dean Street

name: Armadio Style Collective
description: Women’s fashion boutique on Olive Street, Albury stocking mid to high end clothing and accessories, including dresses, tops, bottoms, outerwear, jewellery, bags, footwear and scarves. The store also sells online.
highlights: Mid to high end women’s clothing
Shop on Olive Street plus online store

name: Beechworth Emporium
description: Department store on Camp Street in Beechworth selling men’s and ladies clothing, accessories and footwear. It has traded for over 30 years and occupies a building dating back to the 1850s, describing itself as today’s department store with yesteryear’s service.
highlights: Men’s and ladies clothing, accessories and footwear
On Camp Street in central Beechworth

name: 2 Grey Birds
description: Family owned gift store on Olive Street, Albury describing itself as a treasure trove of gifts, curated hampers, homewares, paper goods and cards. Ranges cover cards, baby and wedding gifts and homewares, with a focus on independent designers and home grown brands.
highlights: Stocks independent designers and Australian brands

name: The Yack Store
description: Shop on High Street in Yackandandah described as an old fashioned emporium with the latest books and gifts. It stocks books, including classic Little Golden Books, and gifts for a range of occasions.
highlights: On High Street in central Yackandandah

name: Giftwrapt Corowa
description: Gift shop on Sanger Street in Corowa selling giftware, hampers and gift vouchers.

name: Who What Why
description: Toy and gift shop on Dean Street, Albury trading under the line "an education in toys". It has been locally owned and operated since 1995 and stocks over 3000 items covering educational toys, games, puzzles, craft supplies and children’s gifts, with brands including Connetix, Schleich, Melissa & Doug and Ravensburger.
highlights: Brands include Connetix, Schleich and Ravensburger
Gifts from baby age up to teenagers

name: Blairs Produce
description: Rural and livestock supplies store on Wagga Road, Lavington. It carries pet food and animal health products, crop protection chemicals and seed, veterinary supplies, produce, garden lines and general merchandise, stocking brands including AgBoss, Blundstone and Bainbridge.

name: Parkside Produce
description: Family owned produce store on Osburn Street, Wodonga supplying stock feed, equine and poultry products, farm supplies and domestic pet food. The store has a drive through, which it describes as the only one in the region.

name: Kellys Mitre 10
description: Locally owned family run hardware store on Elgin Boulevard, Wodonga. It runs a trade centre carrying building materials, is an authorised STIHL dealer for sales and servicing with genuine parts, and stocks rural and animal care products plus workwear and boots. Local delivery and equipment servicing are offered to builders, tradespeople and farmers across the Albury Wodonga region.

name: Rutherglen Home Hardware
description: Independent hardware store on Main Street, Rutherglen carrying a range of home improvement and hardware products for home and weekend projects, with in store shopping, delivery and same day service options.

name: Leather & Thread
description: Furniture store at the corner of Romet Road and McKoy Street in West Wodonga, selling lounges, dining settings, bedroom suites, living room furniture and outdoor ranges. The site also houses Good Night Sleep and La-Z-Boy Albury Wodonga.
highlights: Good Night Sleep bedding on site

name: Whatever Where-ever Craft
description: Patchwork, quilting and sewing shop in Howlong stocking over 2,000 bolts of fabric across brights, florals, reproductions and children’s prints. It also carries patterns, pre-cuts such as jelly rolls, layer cakes and charm squares, kits, books, templates, felt, yarn and notions, and sells online.
highlights: Pre-cuts including jelly rolls and charm squares
Online store as well as shopfront
